Zeppelin.et: Named after Ferdinand Adolf Heinrich August Graf von Zeppelin.

Zepter.et: Middle High German zepter, cepter, scepter, from Latin scēptrum.

Zephir.et: Borrowed from Latin Zephyrus, from Ancient Greek Ζέφυρος (Zéphuros, “Zephyrus, the west wind”).

s: zephyr lily (flowering plant in the genus Zephyranthes)
Zephirblume.et: From Zephir (“zephyr”) + Blume (“flower”), calque of translingual Zephyranthes.
